entities.summary: John Francis Sherrington is an English Catholic prelate who has served as Metropolitan Archbishop of Liverpool since May 2025. He previously served as auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Westminster from 2011 to 2025. He had previously taught at two seminaries and served as part of the clergy of the Diocese of Nottingham.
